title: The Dark Passage
camera: steadicam follow behind KAIRO, deepening darkness, faint glow ahead
action: KAIRO walks deeper into a narrow rocky passage. A faint mysterious light becomes visible in the distance.
expression: not visible; posture is careful, hand trailing the wall
lighting: almost no light; a cold blue-green glow far ahead, warm memory of daylight behind
audio: echoing footsteps, dripping water, the resonant tone growing clearer
dialogue_fa: هرچی جلوتر می‌رفتم، صدا واضح‌تر می‌شد. نمی‌دونستم دارم به چی نزدیک می‌شم...
gloss_en: The further I went, the clearer the sound became. I had no idea what I was getting close to...
continuity: passage bends right before the chamber, recreated in S19
transition: the glow grows until it fills frame, motivating the chamber reveal
image_prompt: Rear tracking shot of KAIRO the stickman walking down a narrow rocky cave passage, one thin hand trailing the wall, spear over his shoulder. The passage narrows and bends to the right; a faint cold blue-green glow leaks from around the bend. Rough stone texture, wet highlights, deep blacks. 2D cinematic animation, claustrophobic composition.
video_prompt: Steadicam follow behind KAIRO walking deeper. He slows, touches the wall, then keeps going. The passage narrows, shadows crowd the edges of frame, and the glow around the bend gradually brightens until it starts to fill the screen.
